mechanics.label: FUEL
mechanics.phaseInitialization: Actual Math.random()*TAU, unseeded. Controlled phase ONLY diagnostics.

tank_separation.limitation: Imported tank visuals bypassed by explicit constructor import stub; tests execute actual Game reward/contact methods with FX/audio/input stubs. No live projectile simulation.

ownership.templateTexturePolicy: No asset textures. disposeModel does not dispose textures; existing halo glow remains externally owned.
ownership.limitation: Recipe tests only: production Pickup.dispose remains detach-only and MUST explicitly gain releaseImportedFuel behavior on integration.

clearance.glyph_backplate_gap_proof: Shape wobble is about game Z and never changes vertex depth; fixed core depth. Strict separated Z slabs cover every wobble, spin and pulse combination.
clearance.method_limits: Finite BVH overlap and bidirectional vertex-to-triangle distance do not find every triangle-interior distance minimum. Conservative radial separating-cylinder bound additionally covers all shell spin angles, pulse range and badge wobbles: all projected shell triangles stay outside its inner edge/chord radius; all core/shape triangles are inside their convex vertex radial maximum. Float tolerance, not collision/physics integration proof.

limitations.renders: Offline Blender reconstructions of actual source rig eye/target/projection/billboard, source geometry, source motion. Halo/additive/postFX/hemisphere/particles/HUD/audio are approximate or not reproduced.
limitations.clearance: Finite BVH overlap and bidirectional vertex-to-triangle distance do not find every triangle-interior distance minimum. Conservative radial separating-cylinder bound additionally covers all shell spin angles, pulse range and badge wobbles: all projected shell triangles stay outside its inner edge/chord radius; all core/shape triangles are inside their convex vertex radial maximum. Float tolerance, not collision/physics integration proof.
limitations.readability: Manual implementation inspection only; small/far detail merging is documented, not a universal recognition study.
limitations.determinism: Generated geometry/names/materials/transforms and GLB are deterministic. Blender binary session metadata may differ; no byte-identical blend promise.

deliberate_kit_reuse: Common frozen spread frame/backplate geometry-generation profile and neutral tint/material language; freshly generated standalone fuel meshes; original drum glyph.

readability.grayscale: Decode sRGB -> linear Rec709 luminance (.2126,.7152,.0722) -> encode sRGB; no contrast enhancement.
readability.assessment: Manual visual inspection required; Drum silhouette and two rolled bands are the primary non-color cues; small/far views require recorded manual assessment, not a text-readability guarantee. Far perspective views are smaller; no claim of text readability or final art approval.
readability.sampling: Contact sheets downsample whole frames with nearest-neighbor only for presentation. Native crop files and small-gameplay-readability.png do not resize assets or pixels.

assessment.large: Drum/canister shape and two hoops distinguish it without text or color alone; original compressed source envelope preserved.
assessment.native_small: At Classic28.30px and perspective near46.64..46.66px badge widths, central body/hoops/panel contrast remain present. At perspective far23.38..25.72px, bands/cap/bevel detail soften or merge; drum silhouette/neutral center panel survive but universal recognition is not claimed.
assessment.kit: Common ring and slate backplate language is deliberate. Frozen shield/spread symbols remain distinct from the compact source-scale fuel drum.
assessment.limits: No human recognition study, formal art approval, final live-game rasterization, HDR/postFX equivalence, or unseen-pixel inspection is claimed. Source collection particles/HUD/audio are numerically sampled, not recreated in these stills.

determinism.method: One fresh independent Blender factory-startup rerun of delivered editable generator; complete GLB SHA256 comparison.
determinism.limits: Demonstrates repeatability on this installed Blender/exporter, not across Blender versions/platforms. Blend session/serialization metadata may differ.
